title: Space Pirates
tagline: Space dogfights in a starfighter you fly with the mouse.
blurb: You fly a little starfighter around a planet and shoot down the raiders before they shoot you. It's two clicks from loading to fighting, which is why I like it.
desc: Space Pirates, the Babylon.js team's open-source 3D space dogfight game. Steer with the mouse, fire cannons and missiles, hit the afterburner. Hosted on kaleerson.com.
author: the Babylon.js team
tags: space ship shooter dogfight fly babylon pirates
